instruction:
You are an electrical design engineer checking `SSC-05-LH-05`, a task-owned synthetic SSC-05 pump station MCC, cable, and protection package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values below for numeric grading. MCC, cable-ampacity, voltage-drop, motor-starting, and protection workflows shape the context only; this instance does not run those tools or parse a real pump schedule, MCC SLD, cable schedule, or protection table.

## Scene

- Design case: `CASE-SSC05-PUMP-MCC-05`
- Pump schedule: `PUMP-05-SCHED-05`
- MCC single line: `MCC-05-SLD-05`
- Cable schedule: `CABLE-05-PUMP-05`
- Protection setting table: `PROT-05-SET-05`
- Pump duty/load basis: `DUTY-05-BASIS-05`
- Power design memo: `MEMO-05-POWER-05`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Pump motor power | {{ pump_motor_kw }} kW |
| Feeder voltage | {{ feeder_voltage_v }} V |
| Motor efficiency | {{ motor_efficiency }} |
| Motor power factor | {{ motor_power_factor }} |
| Starting multiplier | {{ starting_multiplier }} |
| Base cable ampacity | {{ base_cable_ampacity_a }} A |
| Ambient derating factor | {{ ambient_derating_factor }} |
| Grouping derating factor | {{ grouping_derating_factor }} |
| Installation derating factor | {{ installation_derating_factor }} |
| Voltage-drop factor | {{ voltage_drop_mv_per_a_m }} mV/A/m |
| Feeder length | {{ feeder_length_m }} m |
| Maximum voltage drop | {{ max_voltage_drop_percent }} % |
| Overload setting | {{ overload_setting_a }} A |
| Available fault current | {{ available_fault_current_ka }} kA |
| Breaker interrupt rating | {{ breaker_interrupt_rating_ka }} kA |

Checks:

- Running current equals `pump_motor_kw x 1000 / (sqrt(3) x feeder_voltage_v x motor_efficiency x motor_power_factor)`.
- Starting current equals running current times the starting multiplier.
- Derated cable ampacity equals the base ampacity times all three derating factors.
- Voltage drop percent equals `voltage_drop_mv_per_a_m x running_current_a x feeder_length_m / 1000 / feeder_voltage_v x 100`.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when ampacity, voltage-drop, overload, and fault margins are non-negative; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Preserve the object IDs above, state the task-owned synthetic source-pack boundary, and explain whether the baseline source pack passes the docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated SKM evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "running_current_a": <numeric_value>,
  "starting_current_a": <numeric_value>,
  "derated_cable_ampacity_a": <numeric_value>,
  "ampacity_margin_a": <numeric_value>,
  "voltage_drop_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "voltage_drop_margin_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "overload_setting_margin_a": <numeric_value>,
  "short_circuit_margin_ka": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "pump-station-mcc-cable-protection-package"
description = "SSC-05 pump station MCC, motor current, cable ampacity, voltage-drop, and protection metrics"
long_description = "Calculates deterministic SSC-05 pump station MCC metrics from a task-owned synthetic source pack. The template combines pump motor current, starting current, cable ampacity derating, voltage drop, overload margin, short-circuit margin, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "pump-station-mcc-protection"
standards = ["MCC single-line review workflow", "AS/NZS 3008.1.1-style cable ampacity workflow", "SKM PowerTools-style protection workflow"]
tags = ["electrical", "pump-station", "mcc", "motor", "cable", "protection", "voltage-drop", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.pump_motor_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "PUMP-05-SCHED-05 pump motor input basis"
min = 47.02609291601914
max = 47.02609291601914

[params.feeder_voltage_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "MCC-05-SLD-05 three-phase feeder voltage"
min = 415.0
max = 415.0

[params.motor_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "PUMP-05-SCHED-05 motor efficiency"
min = 0.91
max = 0.91

[params.motor_power_factor]
type = "float"
description = "PUMP-05-SCHED-05 motor power factor"
min = 0.88
max = 0.88

[params.starting_multiplier]
type = "float"
description = "DUTY-05-BASIS-05 motor starting current multiplier"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.base_cable_ampacity_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "CABLE-05-PUMP-05 base cable ampacity"
min = 145.0
max = 145.0

[params.ambient_derating_factor]
type = "float"
description = "CABLE-05-PUMP-05 ambient derating factor"
min = 0.92
max = 0.92

[params.grouping_derating_factor]
type = "float"
description = "CABLE-05-PUMP-05 grouping derating factor"
min = 0.87
max = 0.87

[params.installation_derating_factor]
type = "float"
description = "CABLE-05-PUMP-05 installation derating factor"
min = 0.9655172413793103
max = 0.9655172413793103

[params.voltage_drop_mv_per_a_m]
type = "float"
unit = "mV/A/m"
description = "CABLE-05-PUMP-05 source-owned voltage-drop factor"
min = 0.6338278851695152
max = 0.6338278851695152

[params.feeder_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "CABLE-05-PUMP-05 feeder route length"
min = 245.0
max = 245.0

[params.max_voltage_drop_percent]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "DUTY-05-BASIS-05 maximum voltage drop"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.overload_setting_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "PROT-05-SET-05 overload setting"
min = 99.0
max = 99.0

[params.available_fault_current_ka]
type = "float"
unit = "kA"
description = "PROT-05-SET-05 available fault current at the MCC"
min = 22.2
max = 22.2

[params.breaker_interrupt_rating_ka]
type = "float"
unit = "kA"
description = "PROT-05-SET-05 breaker interrupt rating"
min = 25.0
max = 25.0

[outputs.running_current_a]
description = "Pump motor running current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.starting_current_a]
description = "Pump motor starting current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.derated_cable_ampacity_a]
description = "Cable ampacity after derating factors"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.ampacity_margin_a]
description = "Derated cable ampacity minus running current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.voltage_drop_percent]
description = "Pump feeder voltage drop"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.voltage_drop_margin_percent]
description = "Voltage-drop criterion minus calculated voltage drop"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overload_setting_margin_a]
description = "Overload setting minus running current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.short_circuit_margin_ka]
description = "Breaker interrupt rating minus available fault current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when ampacity, voltage-drop, overload, and fault margins are non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001
